title.narrative: Support the TB prevention and treatment response in Tanzania - Tanzania (United Republic) (01-Jan-2024-31-Dec-2026)

description.narrative: Tanzania (United Republic), Tuberculosis, Ministry of Finance of the United Republic of Tanzania (MoF)This program has the following goals: To reduce burden and suffering from Tuberculosis and Leprosy diseases in Tanzania by 2025: -50% reduction in tuberculosis incidence rate (compared to 2015-(306 TB incidence rate per 100,000 population) -75% reduction in the number of tuberculosis deaths (compared to 2015-(58,000 deaths(both HIV negative and HIV positive TB cases)). The objectives of this program are: To increase TB treatment coverage from 53 percent in 2018 to 90 percent in 2025 by innovatively addressing barriers to access, utilization, and the needs of the key and vulnerable populations for TB care and prevention services. To expand access to quality TB diagnostic services, including the adoption of new diagnostic technologies. To maintain the proportion of children with TB among the notified cases at 15 percent and to increase the ratio of ages at '0-4':5-14 years from 1.3 in 2019 to 1.5 by 2025,. To increase RR/MDR-TB cases detected and enrolled for treatment from 54 to 90 percent of the estimated TB cases among the notified by 2025.. To Strengthen management of co-morbidities including collaborative TB/HIV activities, and Prevention of TB for persons at high risks.. To Enhance Multi-Sectoral Collaboration and Action for increased, coordinated and accelerated response towards ending TB by 2025.. To ensure availability of supportive systems and strengthened program management and coordination for the Implementation of TB and Leprosy services by 2025. To implement evidence-based interventions and decision making through institutionalized efficient Monitoring and Evaluation system and coordination of research by 2025.

title.narrative: Coverage / Output indicators targets and results for TZA-T-MOFP04

Treatment success rate- all forms: Percentage of patients with all forms of TB, bacteriologically confirmed plus clinically diagnosed, successfully treated (cured plus treatment completed) among all TB patients notified during a specified period; *includes only those with new and relapse TB
Treatment success rate of RR-TB and/or MDR-TB: Percentage of patients with RR and/or MDR-TB successfully treated
Percentage of people with confirmed RR-TB and/or MDR-TB that began second-line treatment
Number of people with confirmed RR-TB and/or MDR-TB notified
Percentage of new and relapse TB patients tested using WHO recommended rapid diagnostic tests at the time of diagnosis
Percentage of laboratories successfully participating in external quality assurance (EQA) or proficiency testing (PT) schemes
Number of people in contact with TB patients who began preventive therapy
Number of patients with of all forms of TB notified (i.e., bacteriologically confirmed + clinically diagnosed); *includes only those with new and relapse TB
Percentage of districts that produce at least semi-annual analytical reports
TBDT-Other-1:Number of male patients with of all forms of TB notified (i.e., bacteriologically confirmed + clinically diagnosed); *includes only those with new and relapse TB
Number of people with TB (all forms) notified among key affected populations/high risk groups (other than prisoners); *includes only those with new and relapse
Percentage of HIV-positive new and relapse TB patients on ART during TB treatment
Outcome indicators targets and results for TZA-T-MOFP04
On-shelf availability: Percentage of facilities with tracer health products for the three diseases - HIV, TB, malaria (as applicable) available on the day of the visit or day of reporting

TB treatment coverage: Percentage of patients with new and relapse TB that were notified and treated among the estimated number of incident TB in the same year (all forms of TB - bacteriologically confirmed plus clinically diagnosed
Impact indicators targets and results for TZA-T-MOFP04
TB mortality rate per 100,000 population
RR-TB and/or MDR-TB prevalence among new TB patients: Proportion of new TB patients with RR-TB and/or MDR-TB
TB incidence rate per 100,000 population
